response: {"turns":[{"id":"M1:T1","text":"Okay, let's get started. This is our kickoff for the ERTMS/ETCS Functional Requirements Specification, the FRS, and it's the only session we've planned, so let's try to cover everything today."},{"id":"M1:T2","text":"Sure. So for background, this document is mainly about the operational requirements, so you won't find a lot of technical terms in it, just a few."},{"id":"M1:T3","text":"Good to know. Let's start with the basic functioning. What do we need there?"},{"id":"M1:T4","text":"The key thing is speed. ETCS has to work up to a maximum train speed of 500 km/h."},{"id":"M1:T5","text":"Got it. Anything else on basic functioning?"},{"id":"M1:T6","text":"No, that's it."},{"id":"M1:T7","text":"Okay, next topic: operating alongside the existing national train control systems. How should that work?"},{"id":"M1:T8","text":"ETCS has to be compatible with the existing national systems, the ones listed in the CCS TSI. It shouldn't interfere with those national systems, and they shouldn't interfere with it either."},{"id":"M1:T9","text":"Makes sense. Let's move on to operational states. What's needed there?"},{"id":"M1:T10","text":"The ETCS trainborne equipment needs to be able to supervise a whole list of operational states. So that's Full Supervision, Partial Supervision, Staff Responsible, On Sight, Unfitted Line, Train Trip, Post Trip, National operation, meaning STM, then Tandem, Multiple, Shunting, Stand By, and Reversing operation."},{"id":"M1:T11","text":"And for transitions, any transition that happens while the train is moving should, in principle, happen automatically. If a transition has to be acknowledged and the driver doesn't acknowledge it as required, ETCS should trigger a brake application."},{"id":"M1:T12","text":"Okay, got it."},{"id":"M1:T13","text":"Also, during the transition period between two operational states, and that includes going between two different national operations, the supervision has to give at least the same protection as the least restrictive state."},{"id":"M1:T14","text":"And the driver should always see the current operational status on the DMI."},{"id":"M1:T15","text":"Anything else on operational states?"},{"id":"M1:T16","text":"No, nothing else."},{"id":"M1:T17","text":"Alright, what about national values?"},{"id":"M1:T18","text":"Once the national values have been received onboard, they have to stay valid, even if the onboard equipment gets switched off."},{"id":"M1:T19","text":"Okay. And the on board equipment self test, what do we expect there?"},{"id":"M1:T20","text":"At Start Up, the on board equipment should run an automatic self-test."}]}
